gitundo.status.ok: {n} steps — click a line to copy
gitundo.warn.rewrite: These steps rewrite history — only on a branch nobody else uses.
gitundo.warn.destructive: One of these cannot be undone — commit or copy your current state first.
gitundo.case.lastMessage: I wrote the wrong commit message
gitundo.case.uncommit: Undo the commit but keep my changes
gitundo.case.dropCommit: Throw the last commit away entirely
gitundo.case.wrongBranch: I committed on the wrong branch
gitundo.case.deletedBranch: I deleted a branch by mistake
gitundo.case.discardFile: Throw away my edits to a file
gitundo.case.revertPushed: Undo a commit that is already pushed
gitundo.step.softReset: undo the commit, keep the changes
gitundo.step.reflogSafety: note where you can come back to
gitundo.step.hardReset: drop the commit and the changes
gitundo.step.preferRevert: already public — add a revert instead of erasing
gitundo.step.markHere: mark this spot as a new branch
gitundo.step.putBack: move the old branch back to the remote spot
gitundo.step.findSha: find the lost sha in the reflog
gitundo.step.reBranch: recreate a branch at that sha
gitundo.step.lastResort: last resort when the reflog has nothing
gitundo.step.lookFirst: see what you are about to throw away
gitundo.step.fsckStash: if it is gone from the list, look for dangling commits
gitundo.step.revert: add a commit that undoes it
gitundo.step.abortMerge: go back to before the merge
gitundo.step.abortRebase: go back to before the rebase
